description: This file implements the SessionServerAppManager class, which manages session server applications including launching, preloading, state management, and health checks within a Rialto server environment. It handles communication with session servers via IPC, manages their lifecycle, and responds to state changes and pings.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManager
classes.description: Manages session server applications, including launching, preloading, state changes, and health checks, coordinating IPC communication and lifecycle events.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Preloads a specified number of session servers asynchronously.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Initiates a session server application with a given name, state, and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the state of a session server application identified by name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a session server's state changes.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Sends ping requests to all connected session servers.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses for ping requests.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for the session servers.

methods.name: connectSessionServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a session server via IPC.

methods.name: configureSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a session server with necessary parameters via IPC.

methods.name: configurePreloadedSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a preloaded session server for a specific app and state.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Requests a state change for a session server identified by app name.

methods.name: handleSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Handles internal logic when a session server's state changes.

methods.name: handleAck
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment responses for pings.

methods.name: shutdownAllSessionServers
methods.description: Kills all managed session servers and clears the list.

methods.name: launchSessionServer
methods.description: Creates and launches a new session server for a given app.

methods.name: preloadSessionServer
methods.description: Creates and preloads a new session server.

methods.name: getPreloadedServer
methods.description: Retrieves a preloaded and connected session server if available.

methods.name: getServerByAppName
methods.description: Finds a session server by application name.

methods.name: getServerById
methods.description: Finds a session server by server ID.
